d:
An anthropomorphic lizard-like Pokémon with an electric yellow and deep purple body, featuring a single, large, jagged horn on the head and a long, thick tail with a purple bulbous tip. The creature has three fingers on each hand and small, pointed ears. The Gigantamax form is towering with massive, glowing electric yellow energy clouds emanating from the chest and back.
BODY COLOR: electric yellow
